svg.title: About Felix
svg.desc: AI & Data professional focused on business impact; Data Analyst Intern at PT Tunas Ridean Tbk (Tunas Group). Previously built predictive maintenance at Astra Visteon, improving critical-event detection from 0% to 60%. At HPC UG, fine-tunes generative AI and optimizes HPC workloads; co-authored AI reference book ISBN 9286020764751 and mentored 200+ researchers and students.
